/-! ## Parent chains (§40, §42) -/

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, i =>
    match org i with
    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
    | none => []

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
decreases. -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
/-- `OwnedIn` is computed by `|P| + 1` steps of `owR` (decision procedure for §40). -/
theorem ownedIn_iff {P : List Place} {src q : Nat} :
    OwnedIn P src q ↔ kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1) q = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ownedIn_of_kiter P src _ q⟩
  induction h with
  | direct hpl ho hp => exact kiter_up (owR_rule P src) 1 _ (by simp [kiter, owR, hpl, ho, hp])
  | step hpl ho ho' ih =>
    apply kiter_up (owR_rule P src) (P.length + 2) _
    show owR P src (kiter (owR P src) (P.length + 1)) _ = true
    simp [owR, hpl, ho, ih, ho'.lt]

/-- Decidability of `OwnedIn` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedIn P src q) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ ownedIn_iff.symm

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
    match s.A[j]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
(§50). -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨x, -, -, -, hx⟩ := effective_some he
  have hmem : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨j, y, hy, ya, hp, hj, hm⟩
  rcases effOf_cases hx with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, h1, -⟩
  · rw [h0] at hmem; simp at hmem
  · exact h1 hmem

/-- Effective `Modify` of `a` on `p` excludes every active descendant covering `p` (§43,
cases 2–4). -/
theorem no_desc_of_modify {s : S3} {a j p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[j]? = some y)
    (ya : y.active = true) (hp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hj : a ∈ s.ancs j)
    (he : effective s a p = some .modify) : False := by
  obtain ⟨x, -, -, -, hx⟩ := effective_some he
  have hmem : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨j, y, hy, ya, hp, hj, rfl⟩
  rcases effOf_cases hx with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, h1⟩
  · rw [h0] at hmem; simp at hmem
  · cases h1

/-- The effective anchor of an authority with an origin is strictly older than it (§44). -/
theorem effAnchor_lt {s : S3} {x o : Nat} (ho : s.org x = some o) (hlt : o < x) :
    s.effAnchor x < x := by
  unfold S3.effAnchor S3.ancs
  rw [chain_cons ho hlt]
  exact chain_lt (by rw [chain_cons ho hlt, List.getLastD_cons]; exact List.getLastD_mem_cons)

/-- `store` changes no `EffAnchorOK` whose effective anchor is not the stored authority (§44,
§65). -/

namespace Witness

open Examples

/-- The statics of the run (§47; DS-v1 non-vacuity): stack value 0, storage 1 with cells 2 and 3,
destinations 4 and 5. -/
def wst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), false),
    ((some 1, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- Initial state (§47; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
def d0 : DState := DState.init wst
/-- `derive(1, [2, 3], Modify)`: authority 4, held by frame 0 (§60; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
def d1 : DState := ⟨deriveEff d0.kern 1 [2, 3] .modify, d0.stacks, d0.fresh⟩
/-- `store(4, 0)`: authority 4 becomes `internal`, held by the stack value 0 (§65; DS-v1
non-vacuity). -/
def d2 : DState := ⟨storeEff d1.kern 4 0, d1.stacks, d1.fresh⟩
/-- `newStack(1, 4)` (DS-v1, §56). -/
def d3 : DState := newStackEff d2 1 4
/-- The stack registered by `newStack(1, 4)` (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st3 : Stack := ⟨1, 4, footprint d2.kern.P 1, 0, [], []⟩
/-- `mark(0)`: mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` (DS-v1, §58). -/
def d4 : DState := ⟨d3.kern, d3.stacks.set 0 (markMeta 0 st3 d3.fresh), d3.fresh + 1⟩
/-- The stack after the first mark (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st4 : Stack := markMeta 0 st3 d3.fresh
/-- `push(0, 1, 4)`: `split(4, [[2]])`, `store(5, 4)` (DS-v1, Part XIV, §77). -/
def d5 : DState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff d4.kern st4.internal [cellsOf st4 st4.top 1]) d4.kern.A.length 4,
    d4.stacks.set 0 (pushMeta st4 1 d4.kern.A.length 4), d4.fresh⟩
/-- The stack after the first push: block `⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩` (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st5 : Stack := pushMeta st4 1 d4.kern.A.length 4
/-- `mark(0)`: mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩` (DS-v1, §58). -/
def d6 : DState := ⟨d5.kern, d5.stacks.set 0 (markMeta 0 st5 d5.fresh), d5.fresh + 1⟩
/-- The stack after the second mark (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st6 : Stack := markMeta 0 st5 d5.fresh
/-- `push(0, 1, 5)`: `split(4, [[3]])`, `store(6, 5)` (DS-v1, Part XIV, §77). -/
def d7 : DState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff d6.kern st6.internal [cellsOf st6 st6.top 1]) d6.kern.A.length 5,
    d6.stacks.set 0 (pushMeta st6 1 d6.kern.A.length 5), d6.fresh⟩
/-- The stack after the second push: blocks `⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩`, `⟨1, 1, 6, 5⟩` (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st7 : Stack := pushMeta st6 1 d6.kern.A.length 5
/-- `release(6)` by the program (§62; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
def d8 : DState := ⟨releaseEff d7.kern 6, d7.stacks, d7.fresh⟩
/-- The second mark (DS-v1, §58). -/
def m1 : Mark := ⟨0, 1, 1⟩
/-- `rewind(0, ⟨0, 1, 1⟩)`: `split(4, [[3]])`, `release(7)` (DS-v1, §61, §62). -/
def d9 : DState :=
  ⟨releaseEff (splitEff d8.kern st7.internal [above st7 m1]) d8.kern.A.length,
    d8.stacks.set 0 (rewindMeta st7 m1), d8.fresh⟩
/-- The stack after the rewind (DS-v1, §46). -/
def st9 : Stack := rewindMeta st7 m1
/-- The block of authority 5 (DS-v1, §46). -/
def x5 : Blk := ⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩
/-- `grow(0, 5, 1)`: `release(5)`, `split(4, [[2, 3]])`, `store(8, 4)` (DS-v1, Part XIV,
§77). -/
def d10 : DState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 1)])
      (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst,
    d9.stacks.set 0 (growMeta st9 x5 1 (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length), d9.fresh⟩

/-- The run up to the second push is library-reachable (DS-v1; §47, Part XIV derived `issue`,
§77). -/
theorem d7_reach : DReach K0 wst d7 := by
  have r1 : DReach K0 wst d1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  have r2 : DReach K0 wst d2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
  have r3 : DReach K0 wst d3 := .step r2 (.newStack (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))
  have r4 : DReach K0 wst d4 := .step r3 (.mark (.ok (st := st3) (by decide)))
  have r5 : DReach K0 wst d5 := .step r4
    (.push (.ok (st := st4) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))))
  have r6 : DReach K0 wst d6 := .step r5 (.mark (.ok (st := st5) (by decide)))
  exact .step r6
    (.push (.ok (st := st6) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))))

/-- The run up to the rewind is library-reachable (DS-v1; §62, Part XIV derived `reset`, §78). -/
theorem d9_reach : DReach K0 wst d9 :=
  .step (.step d7_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide)))))
    (.rewind (.ok (st := st7) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))))

/-- **Non-vacuity of the DS-v1 operations** (§58 outcomes). In `d7`, `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩` is
rejected: block 6, derived from `internal` 4, covers cell 3 above the mark
(`rewind_rejects_live_above`); `grow` of block 5, which is not at the top, fails (DS-v1 "fail
/-- `release(5)` by the program, after the rewind (§62; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
def d11 : DState := ⟨releaseEff d9.kern 5, d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩
/-- `derive(4, [3], Modify)` by the program: authority 8 on cell 3, above the current top (§60;
DS-v1 reading of "above"). -/
def d12 : DState := ⟨deriveEff d11.kern 4 [3] .modify, d11.stacks, d11.fresh⟩
/-- The first mark (DS-v1, §58). -/
def m0 : Mark := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
/-- A callee frame with no parameter and no local, entered after the rewind (§72; DS-v1 reading
of the order of `fail` and the right of §36). -/
def d13 : DState := ⟨enterEff d9.kern [] [], d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩

/-- **Reading of "a cell above m"** (DS-v1, §46). In `d12`, authority 8, active and derived from
`internal` 4, covers cell 3, at a position above the top of mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` but above the current
top too, hence not among the cells `rewind` returns (`above`): `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is `ok`. Under the
reading "any cell at a position at or above the top of `m`", it is rejected. -/
theorem reading_above :
    DReach K0 wst d12 ∧ d12.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ ∧
    st9.internal ∈ d12.kern.ancs 8 ∧ 3 ∈ st9.cells.drop m0.top ∧ 3 ∉ above st9 m0 ∧
    ∃ D', RewindStep K0 0 m0 d12 (.ok D') := by
  have r11 : DReach K0 wst d11 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide))))
  have r12 : DReach K0 wst d12 := .step r11 (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨r12, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    ⟨_, .ok (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))⟩⟩

/-- **Readings of the order of checks and of `extra = 0`** (DS-v1, §58, §36). (1) In `d13`, a callee
with no right on the stack value (`¬ AdminRight`) rewinds to the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩`: the
outcome is `fail` (dead mark checked first); with the right of §36 checked first it is `reject`.
(2) In `d9`, `grow(0, 5, 0)` is rejected (`extra = 0`), while the sequence `release`, static checks,
in-place check, `split`, `store` of the same region would be `ok`. (3) In `d3`, `push(0, 3, 4)` asks
for more cells than the storage has: `fail` (availability), although the requested cells are not all
in the storage. -/
theorem reading_order :
    DReach K0 wst d13 ∧ ¬ AdminRight d13.kern st9 ∧ RewindStep K0 0 m1 d13 .fail ∧
    GrowStep K0 0 5 0 d9 .reject ∧
    ReleaseStep 5 d9.kern (.ok (releaseEff d9.kern 5)) ∧
    IssueStatic (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.entry (cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)) x5.dst ∧
    InPlace st9 x5 0 ∧
    SplitStep K0 st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)] (releaseEff d9.kern 5)
      (.ok (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)])) ∧
    StoreStep (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst
      (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)])
      (.ok (storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal
        [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)]) (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst)) ∧
    PushStep K0 0 3 4 d3 .fail := by
  have r13 : DReach K0 wst d13 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.enter (.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨r13, by decide, .dead (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide),
    .noExtra (st := st9) (x := x5) (by decide) (by decide) rfl, .ok (by decide), by decide,
    by decide, .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    .fail (st := st3) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- **Reading of `mark`: no right required** (DS-v1, non-normative; §36, §58). In `d13`, a callee
frame with no right on the stack value 0 (no `AdminRight`, no `Observe` right, no valid
`writeShared` through any authority, §68) marks stack 0: `ok`, a mark appended to the metadata.
Under the reading of §36 ¶1 (metadata modified "to the extent permitted by the applicable
rights"), these facts give `reject`. -/
theorem reading_mark :
    DReach K0 wst d13 ∧ d13.stacks[0]? = some st9 ∧ ¬ AdminRight d13.kern st9 ∧
    ¬ HasRight d13.kern .observe 0 ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range d13.kern.A.length, ¬ WriteSharedPre K0 d13.kern a (footprint d13.kern.P 0)) ∧
    MarkStep 0 d13 (.ok ⟨d13.kern, d13.stacks.set 0 (markMeta 0 st9 d13.fresh), d13.fresh + 1⟩) :=
  ⟨reading_order.1, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `transfer(4, 5)` by the program after the first push: the block value, holding block authority
5, moves from place 4 to place 5, and place 4 becomes `Moved` (§63; DS-v1 reading of the `grow`

/-- `release` keeps the identities of the authorities (§62, `ok` effect; support for DS-v1). -/
theorem releaseEff_len (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).A.length = s.A.length := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> simp

/-- `release` changes no initialization (§62, `ok` effect; support for DS-v1). -/
theorem releaseEff_I (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).I = s.I := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl

/-- `release` changes no place (§62, `ok` effect; support for DS-v1). -/
theorem releaseEff_P (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl

/-- The leaf `dst` of a usable place belongs to its own footprint (§40; support for DS-v1). -/
theorem mem_footprint_self {s : S3} {d : Nat} (hu : s.Usable d) (hl : isLeaf s.P d) :
    d ∈ footprint s.P d :=
  mem_footprint.2 ⟨hu.lt, hl, hu.lt, .inl rfl⟩

/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/

/-- `rewind_rejects_live_above` (DS-v1, non-normative: "rewind m … rejects if an active authority
derived from internal covers a cell above m"): for a live mark `m` of an existing stack, if an
active authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, `rewind m` has the outcome
`reject` and no other: either the administrative right of §36 fails, or `split` of `internal` on
the cells above `m` is rejected, since `internal` no longer has effective `Modify` on that cell
(§43, §61.1). -/
theorem rewind_rejects_live_above {k : K} {D : DState} {j : Nat} {st : Stack} {m : Mark}
    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (hm : LiveMark j st m) {x l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : D.kern.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hx : st.internal ∈ D.kern.ancs x)
    (hly : l ∈ y.footprint) (hl : l ∈ above st m) :
    RewindStep k j m D .reject ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep k j m D o → o = .reject := by
  have hn : ¬ SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [above st m] := fun h =>
    no_desc_of_modify hy ya hly hx (h.modifyOn _ (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl)
  refine ⟨?_, fun o ho => ?_⟩
  · by_cases ha : AdminRight D.kern st
    · exact .split hst hm ha (.reject hn)
    · exact .static hst hm ha
  · cases ho with
    | noStack => rfl
    | dead h hd => rw [hst] at h; cases h; exact absurd hm hd
    | static => rfl
    | split => rfl
    | release => rfl
    | ok h _ _ hsp =>
      rw [hst] at h; cases h
      exact absurd (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).1 hn

/-- `rewind_keeps_older_marks` (DS-v1, non-normative: "otherwise returns those cells to available
and removes m and every mark above it"; §46 metadata, §62 `ok` effect): after an `ok` of
`rewind m`, the marks of the stack are exactly those older than `m`, its top is the top of `m`
(the cells above `m` are available again), the other stacks are unchanged, and no initialization
changes. -/
theorem rewind_keeps_older_marks {k : K} {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark}
    (h : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D')) {st : Stack} (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st)
    {pre post : List Mark} (hs : st.marks = pre ++ m :: post) (hpre : m ∉ pre) :
    (∃ st', D'.stacks[j]? = some st' ∧ st'.marks = pre ∧ st'.top = m.top) ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ j → D'.stacks[i]? = D.stacks[i]?) ∧ D'.kern.I = D.kern.I := by
  cases h with
  | ok hst₀ _ _ hsp hrl =>

structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
